name: ECS-Aggregation
title: Switch Enterprise Campus Aggregation
summary: 1U full-depth 48x 25G SFP28 + 6x 100G QSFP28 L3 aggregation switch with MC-LAG, hot-swap PSUs/fans.

requires: UniFi OS console / gateway running UniFi Network (8.5.6+)

extra.routing: spec lists only static + inter-VLAN routing; no OSPF/BGP

gotchas: All-optical: zero RJ45 data ports — every link needs an SFP28/QSFP28 module or DAC (budget it).
QSFP28 breakout is not supported, so the 100G ports cannot fan out to 4x25G.
MC-LAG HA only pairs with a second ECS-Aggregation — true redundancy means buying two.
Full-depth 1U, 340W, 5 hot-swap fans: needs a 4-post rack in a real equipment room, not a closet shelf.
Only static/inter-VLAN routing listed (L3 lite) — no dynamic routing for a true campus core.
best_for: campus distribution layer aggregating many 10/25G access switches
